name: Navitas Semiconductor
outlook:
What Navitas Semiconductor says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: net revenuesFourth quarter 2026 net revenues are expected to increase to $16.0 million, plus or minus $0.5 million, which at the midpoint represents 14% sequential growth and 119% year-over-year growth.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: non-GAAP gross marginNon-GAAP gross margin is expected to be 40.5%, plus or minus 100 basis points, which at the midpoint represents a 50-basis point increase.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: non-GAAP operating expensesNon-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be $25.0 million, plus or minus $1.0 million, which includes the operational expenses associated with the acquired Claros business.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
